result.title: Teaching PPG How not Who: Fixed-Effects Distillation from ECG
result.summary: ECG is widely used to teach PPG-only models, yet what it teaches is unexamined. Wearables are valued for tracking how a person's cardiovascular state changes, but ECG-to-PPG distillation mostly learns who the person is. A per-recording mean, the trait, holds 40-59% of a frozen ECG teacher's target, and pooled students memorise it without carrying it to new recordings. The raw alignment cosine misses this, since a constant predictor scores 0.793. Across 34 runs, the more identity a student memorises, the less state it learns. Fixed-effects distillation subtracts each recording's mean from prediction and target, so the trait cancels exactly, while a pooled anchor keeps it. State agreement more than doubles, within-person labels improve while age and sex do not, and the gain holds on two backbones and two further databases. Conditioning on the recording turns distillation toward the within-person changes that wearables monitor.

AI.brief_summary: 论文考察 ECG→PPG 蒸馏究竟传递了什么，发现逐记录均值（个体特质）占冻结教师目标的 40–59%、池化学生会记住它却无法迁移到新记录，并提出 fixed-effects 蒸馏减去每条记录的均值以消除特质、保留状态变化。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「恒定预测器即可在原始对齐余弦上得 0.793」的诊断，以及用固定效应剥离记录级不变成分、分离「记住了什么」与「真正学到什么」的思路，可能为 LVR 中 latent 相似度指标设计与推理状态内容评估提供可核查线索。
